title: CSM build suite config namespace
description: Bounded, non-authority presentation preferences for the csm-build namespace of csm-skills-config/1. Only output presentation is configurable; dispatch decisions, write scope, commit/push authorization, lifecycle transitions, state authority, and repair policy are never granted here. Unknown keys are rejected.

verbosity.description: Build narration level; never changes execution, validation, or lifecycle behavior.

reportStyle.description: Style of build reports and receipts; never changes artifact ownership, schemas, or terminal-state rules.
